title: Jun modulates endoplasmic reticulum stress-associated ferroptosis in dorsal root ganglia neurons during neuropathic pain by regulating Timp1.
authors: Lin, Ziqiang; Wang, Yi; Deng, Yingdong; Li, Lu; Cao, Yu; Wang, Suo; Zhang, Xiangsheng; Ding, Guoda; Cheng, Jiurong; Tang, Simin; Zhou, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Jun通过调控Timp1介导神经病理性疼痛中背根神经节神经元铁死亡与内质网应激，虽含转录因子预测和分子对接，但核心是疾病机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度不足。
abstract: Neuropathic pain (NP) is a complex disorder caused by lesions or diseases affecting the somatosensory nervous system, severely impacting patients' quality of life. Recent studies suggest ferroptosis may be involved in NP induction, but its precise mechanisms remain unclear. We used GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analyses to functionally annotate ferroptosis-related differentially expressed genes (FRDs). Through STRING and the maximum cluster centrality (MCC) algorithm, we identified five hub FRDs (Jun, Timp1, Egfr, Cdkn1a, Cdkn2a). Single-cell analysis revealed significant expression of Jun and Timp1 in neurons. Our study confirmed the association between ferroptosis and endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS) in NP and validated changes in hub FRD expression across various NP animal models. In vitro experiments demonstrated that Jun regulates neuronal ferroptosis and ERS, particularly by modulating Timp1 expression. Transcription factor prediction and JASPAR binding site analysis elucidated the regulatory network involving Jun. ROC curve analysis of external datasets highlighted the diagnostic potential of hub FRDs and ERS-related differentially expressed genes (ERSRDs) in NP. Using the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD), we identified estradiol (E2) as a potential therapeutic drug targeting hub FRDs and ERSRDs. Molecular docking predicted its binding sites with Jun and Timp1, and in vivo experiments confirmed that E2 alleviated NP and reversed the expression of Jun and Timp1. This study underscores the crucial role of Jun and Timp1 in the interplay between ferroptosis and ERS, offering new insights and promising avenues for NP treatment.
abstract_zh: 神经病理性疼痛（NP）是一种由躯体感觉神经系统损伤或疾病引起的复杂疾病，严重影响患者的生活质量。近期研究表明，铁死亡（ferroptosis）可能参与NP的诱导过程，但其确切机制尚不明确。我们采用GO和KEGG通路富集分析对铁死亡相关差异表达基因（FRDs）进行功能注释。通过STRING和最大团中心性（MCC）算法，我们鉴定了五个核心FRDs（Jun、Timp1、Egfr、Cdkn1a、Cdkn2a）。单细胞分析显示Jun和Timp1在神经元中显著表达。我们的研究证实了NP中铁死亡与内质网应激（ERS）之间的关联，并在多种NP动物模型中验证了核心FRD表达的变化。体外实验表明，Jun调节神经元铁死亡和ERS，特别是通过调控Timp1表达。转录因子预测和JASPAR结合位点分析阐明了涉及Jun的调控网络。外部数据集的ROC曲线分析强调了核心FRDs和ERS相关差异表达基因（ERSRDs）在NP中的诊断潜力。利用比较毒物基因组学数据库（CTD），我们确定雌二醇（E2）为靶向核心FRDs和ERSRDs的潜在治疗药物。分子对接预测了其与Jun和Timp1的结合位点，体内实验证实E2缓解了NP并逆转了Jun和Timp1的表达。本研究强调了Jun和Timp1在铁死亡与ERS相互作用中的关键作用，为NP治疗提供了新见解和有前景的途径。
